parameters.help_en: The business background of the data import, which helps reduce communication costs
parameters.help_zh: 数据导入的业务背景，以减少沟通成本
parameters.name: comment

fields.help_en: The attachment key of the imported data. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
fields.help_zh: 导入数据的附件Key（AttachmentKey），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html获取该参数的值
fields.name: attachment_name

fields.help_en: The reason for the data import
fields.name: classify

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the first row of the CSV file contains column names. Valid values:
true: The first row of the CSV file contains column names.
false: The first row of the CSV file contains data.

If FileType is set to CSV, this parameter is required
fields.help_zh:
CSV格式的类型，取值如下：
true：CSV表格首行是字段名。
false：CSV表格首行是数据。

如果FileType为CSV，该参数必填
fields.name: csv_first_row_is_column_def

fields.help_en:
The ID of the database. Databases are classified into physical databases and logical databases:
Physical database ID: You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter.
Logical database ID: You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
fields.help_zh:
数据库ID（DatabaseId），数据库分为物理库和逻辑库两种：
物理库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值。
逻辑库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值
fields.name: db_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:
true: The database is a logical database.
false: The database is a physical database.

If you set this parameter to true, the destination database must be a logical database
fields.help_zh:
是否为逻辑库，取值如下：
true：逻辑库
false：物理库

如果取值为true，目标数据库必须为逻辑库
fields.name: logic

fields.help_en: The list of databases to which data is to be imported. Currently, you can import data to only one database at a time
fields.help_zh: 待导入的数据库列表，当前仅支持导入一个库
fields.name: db_item_list

fields.help_en:
The execution method of the ticket. Valid values:
COMMITOR: The submitter executes the ticket after the ticket is approved.
AUTO: The ticket is automatically executed after it is approved.
LAST_AUDITOR: The last approver executes the ticket after the ticket is approved
fields.help_zh:
工单执行方式，取值如下：
COMMITOR : 审批通过后，提交者执行。
AUTO : 审批通过后，自动执行。
LAST_AUDITOR : 审批通过后，最后一个审批人执行
fields.name: exec_mode

fields.help_en:
The encoding format of the file. Valid values:
AUTO: Automatic recognition.
UTF-8: UTF-8 encoding.
GBK: GBK encoding.
ISO-8859-1: ISO-8859-1 encoding
fields.help_zh:
文件编码，取值如下：
AUTO：自动识别
UTF-8：UTF8编码
GBK：GBK编码
ISO-8859-1：ISO-8859-1编码
fields.name: file_encoding

fields.help_en:
The type of the file. Valid values:
SQL: SQL file.
CSV: CSV file.
EXCEL: Excel file.
JSON: JSON file. Only specific databases, such as MongoDB, support JSON files
fields.help_zh:
文件类型，取值如下：
SQL：SQL文件。
CSV：CSV文件。
EXCEL：EXCEL文件。
JSON：JSON文件。仅部分数据库支持选择JSON，例如MongoDB
fields.name: file_type

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to ignore errors. Valid values:
true: Ignores errors. If an error occurs, the failed SQL script is skipped and the execution continues.
false: Does not ignore errors. If an error occurs, the subsequent SQL scripts are interrupted and no longer executed
fields.help_zh:
是否忽略报错，取值如下：
true：忽略，遇到错误会跳过当前失败SQL脚本，继续执行。
false：不忽略，遇到出错则中断后面的SQL脚本，不再执行
fields.name: ignore_error

fields.help_en:
The import mode. Valid values:
FAST_MODE: Fast mode. The file is read during the execution phase, and the SQL statements are directly executed in the specified destination database. This mode has lower security than the safe mode but higher execution efficiency.
SAFE_MODE: Safe mode. The file is parsed during the precheck phase, and the SQL or CSV data is cached in the database. During the execution phase, the data is read from the cache and executed in the specified destination database. This mode has higher security but lower execution efficiency than the fast mode
fields.help_zh:
导入模式，取值如下：
FAST_MODE：极速模式，在执行阶段读取文件，将SQL语句直接执行到指定的目标库。该模式安全性相比安全模式要低，但是执行时效较高。
SAFE_MODE：安全模式，在预检查阶段会解析文件并将SQL或CSV数据缓存入库，执行时再从缓存库中读出来执行到指定的目标库。该模式安全性较好，但是执行时效相比极速模式要低
fields.name: import_mode

fields.help_en:
The insert type. Valid values:

INSERT: The database checks the primary key when data is inserted. If a duplicate primary key exists, an error is reported.
INSERT_IGNORE: If an identical record already exists in the table, the new data is ignored.
REPLACE_INTO: If a row of data already exists in the table based on the primary key or unique index, the existing row is deleted before the new data is inserted.

If FileType is set to CSV, this parameter is required
fields.help_zh:
插入类型，取值如下：

INSERT：插入数据时数据库会检查主键（PrimaryKey），如果出现重复会报错。
INSERT_IGNORE：如果表中已经存在相同的记录，则忽略当前新数据。
REPLACE_INTO：如果表中已经有某行数据（根据主键或者唯一索引判断），则先删除此行数据，然后插入新的数据。

如果FileType为CSV，该参数必填
fields.name: insert_type

fields.help_en:
The attachment key of the rollback SQL statement. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

If RollbackSqlType is set to ATTACHMENT, this parameter is required
fields.help_zh:
回滚SQL附件Key（AttachmentKey），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html获取该参数的值。

如果RollbackSqlType为ATTACHMENT，该参数必填
fields.name: rollback_attachment_name

fields.help_en:
The rollback SQL statement.
If RollbackSqlType is set to TEXT, this parameter is required
fields.help_zh:
回滚SQL语句。
如果RollbackSqlType为TEXT，该参数必填
fields.name: rollback_sql

fields.help_en:
The submission method of the rollback SQL statement. Valid values:
TEXT: Text.
ATTACHMENT: Attachment
fields.help_zh:
回滚SQL的提交方式，取值如下：
TEXT：文本
ATTACHMENT：附件
fields.name: rollback_sql_type

fields.help_en:
The name of the destination table to which data in the CSV file is imported.
If FileType is set to CSV, this parameter is required
fields.help_zh:
选择CSV格式文件导入数据的目标表。
如果FileType为CSV，该参数必填
fields.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The attachment key of the ticket, which is used to supplement the ticket information. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 工单附件Key，补充当前工单信息。可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: attachment_key

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account that actually calls the API operation
parameters.help_zh: 实际调用API的用户的阿里云账号UID
parameters.name: real_login_user_uid

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
